text_03: I’m a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) offering online therapy to adults and couples across California. My background includes years of experience supporting clients through anxiety, depression, relationship stress, trauma, substance use, and major life transitions.
text_04: My style is warm, collaborative, and gently direct. I value honesty, curiosity, and respect for your pace. You will not be pushed into anything before you are ready, and you will not be treated as “broken.” Instead, we’ll look together at how your history, nervous system, values, and current contexts are shaping your experience—and what it might mean to move toward a life that feels more grounded, meaningful, and spacious.
text_05: In our work, I often draw on mindfulness and embodied awareness, helping you notice what is happening in the present moment with a little more compassion and a little less judgment. From there, we can explore new choices and new ways of relating to yourself, your emotions, and the people in your life. I also offer neurodynamic-style breathwork and values-based coaching for individuals seeking more experiential work or support outside of traditional therapy settings.
